component.name: Phidler
component.summary: Visual CAD for photonic integrated circuit layout

description.p: Phidler is a graphical CAD application for photonic integrated circuit layout, built on gdsfactory. Place and route components, export GDS, and run FDTD simulations of your layout with the bundled photonfdtd solver.

Adds a Circuit tab that simulates the whole chip as a circuit of physics-based models (operating point, voltage and wavelength sweeps, time domain), a lithium niobate palette of voltage-controlled switches, and component files: parts with layout, pins and model in one file, imported, kept in library folders and exported from a selection. Needs photonfdtd 0.16.

Runs FDTD on photonfdtd 0.15's JAX engine, on the GPU when JAX sees one, adds a Train tab that fits a region of the layout to a task like a neural network (with a built-in binary priority encoder), and a JAX GPU check.
